_source: Shape of a Twilio Programmable Messaging REST API error response as documented in Twilio's Messaging webhook and Message resource reference (researched 2026-10-03); hand-written, not captured from a real account. Numbers are the fictional +1555555010x series; the account SID is Twilio's documented ACXXX… placeholder and the message SIDs are made up.
_description: POST /Messages.json refused: the recipient texted STOP (400, error 21610).

response.message: Attempt to send to unsubscribed recipient
